scope: Local TypeScript SDK and synthetic browser boundary fixtures; no installed browser, TLS/network/media playback, physical device or full fallback qualification.
implementation: BrowserClient exposes the immutable actual physical control transport chosen during construction; caller option mutation cannot claim a different substrate.

CanonicalWebRtcSignaling refuses non-WebSocket or already retired control before transferring peer ownership. Actual ICE failure retires the same peer/listeners and preserves the original offer operation without closing the borrowed client or sending a replacement.

Capture can be cancelled while permission remains pending. Already-cancelled and invalid-budget calls do not prompt. Cancel/timeout stop each late supplied track; success removes the cancellation callback and transfers capture ownership. Positive fractional remaining budgets are preserved.
